follow-up time: Weekly until 24 hours before induction of labor
outcome: Cesarean section for non-reassuring fetal status (NRFS)
cohort: 327 small-for-gestational-age (SGA) fetuses with normal umbilical artery PI (< 95th centile), delivered at > 37 weeks' gestation
finding: While abnormal uterine artery Doppler indices at the time of SGA diagnosis were associated with an increased risk of adverse perinatal outcomes, they did not improve the predictive value of brain Doppler indices.
